title.zh: 2026 国赛 B 题 · 无线电干扰源的快速自动定位与清除
title.en: 2026 CUMCM Problem B · Rapid Localization and Clearance of Radio Interference Sources

shortDescription.zh: 2026 全国大学生数学建模竞赛 B 题：以“覆盖保证定理”把 100% 清除转化为可证明的几何覆盖，用鲁棒布点与融合式在线路径规划逼近理论下界。200+600 局与 120 局演练均 100% 清除，问题四平均 542.9 s/源、仅高于理论下界 13%。
shortDescription.en: 2026 CUMCM Problem B: a coverage-guarantee theorem reduces 100% clearance to provable geometric coverage, combined with robust station layout and fused online path planning. 200 + 600 runs and 120 runs all achieved 100% clearance; Problem 4 averaged 542.9 s/source, only 13% above the theoretical lower bound.

title.zh: “工程 / 数据 / 认知”三大飞轮自进化系统

shortDescription.zh: 以零侵入旁路架构为流水线提供健康检查、数据质量检测与方法论复盘的自进化系统；7 条零侵入红线 + 62 个单元测试 + CI + AST 静态扫描保障工程质量，真实运行中检出字段 100% 缺失、将 139 条监控异常聚类为 9 类错误模式。
shortDescription.en: A self-evolution system providing zero-intrusion sidecar health checks, data-quality detection and methodology review; 7 zero-intrusion red lines, 62 unit tests, CI and AST-based static rule scanning. In production it detected a 100%-missing data field and clustered 139 monitoring anomalies into 9 error patterns.

shortDescription.zh: 人机边界协议（HABP）下的 LLM Agent 研发：以“数据溯源—假设识别—逻辑反向推演”三重质疑机制界定智能体的输出边界，负责财务计算与风控校验等确定性任务的规则实现。
shortDescription.en: LLM-agent R&D under a Human-AI Boundary Protocol (HABP): defined agent output boundaries via a triple-challenge mechanism (data provenance → assumption identification → reverse logical deduction), and implemented deterministic financial-computation and risk-validation rules.

title.zh: AlphaForge · 多因子选股与回测系统

shortDescription.zh: 三层 100 分制评分体系（基本面 / 技术面 / 资金面）+ 21 个二级行业自适应阈值，两段式“形态预过滤 + 质量打分”选股，配套 214 个自动化测试与 Web 可视化看板。
shortDescription.en: A three-layer 100-point scoring framework (fundamental / technical / money-flow) with adaptive thresholds across 21 sub-industries, a two-stage selection pipeline, 214 automated tests and a web dashboard.

shortDescription.zh: 完整建模 A 股 T+1、涨跌停、印花税、滑点等交易摩擦与凯利公式仓位管理（单票仓位约束 + 行业风险系数调整）的回测引擎。
shortDescription.en: A backtesting engine that fully models A-share market frictions (T+1, price limits, stamp duty, slippage) and Kelly-criterion position sizing with per-stock and per-industry risk constraints.

title.zh: 工程商机罗盘 · 工程企业市场机会智能分析助手
title.en: Engineering Opportunity Compass · Market-Opportunity Intelligence for Engineering Firms

shortDescription.zh: 7 人团队 MEM 课程 PBL 项目（进行中）：把工程师从“人肉盯网站筛公告”中解放出来——公开渠道采集 → RAG 知识库问答 → LLM 机会抽取 → 可解释的 A/B/C 评分 → 看板与周报 Agent。我担任 AI 开发组组长。
shortDescription.en: Ongoing 7-member MEM course PBL project: from manual tender-announcement screening to an automated pipeline — public-source collection → RAG knowledge base → LLM opportunity extraction → explainable A/B/C scoring → dashboard and weekly-report agent. I led the AI development group.

title.zh: 社交媒体投资者情绪与市场关注度研究
title.en: Social-Media Investor Sentiment and Market Attention

shortDescription.zh: 毓琇书院“青年科学家成长营”新生早期科研项目：担任小组爬虫开发主力，基于 Requests 与浏览器自动化分三批采集雪球网数据并完成清洗与质量说明。
shortDescription.en: Early-research training project at Yuxiu College's "Young Scientist Growth Camp": lead crawler developer, collecting Xueqiu data with Requests and browser automation in three batches.

title.zh: 《重走西迁路》· AI 历史影像复原纪录片
title.en: Retracing the Wartime Relocation · AI-Restored Historical Documentary

shortDescription.zh: 校外 AI 视频创作项目：以南大前身国立中央大学抗战西迁为题材，运用 Seedance 2.0 沿“南京—武汉—宜昌—重庆—成都”路线完成约 330 条 AI 视频的提示词工程、生成与剪辑。
shortDescription.en: AI video project on the wartime relocation of Nanjing University's predecessor: prompt engineering, generation, and editing of ~330 AI clips with Seedance 2.0 along the Nanjing–Wuhan–Yichang–Chongqing–Chengdu route.
